Subject: Redwood MAP — Week 3 kickoff & checklist

Team — kicking off this week’s MAP checkpoint. Attached is the working MAP (NH_MAP_v3.xlsx) and the first pass of the runbook (runbook_draft.md). High-level goals for this week:

- Confirm namespaces & cert provisioning (owner: Marissa)
- Finalize DB migration window (owner: NovaHealth dev ops / Emily)
- Validate performance baseline on staging (owner: Connor)
- Sign off on cutover steps and rollback triggers (owners: Rishi / Emily)

Proposed milestone: internal go/no-go review Thu 11/13; final cutover scheduled for 11/20 pending sign-off. Please update the MAP spreadsheet with status and ETA prior to Thu.

Attachments: NH_MAP_v3.xlsx, runbook_draft.md

Thanks —
Rishi Malhotra

Thanks Rishi — reviewed the MAP and runbook. Quick updates from our side: 

- Certs: our security team can get wildcard certs issued but need the exact FQDNs by EOD Mon 11/10.
- DB migration: target window 11/20 02:00–04:00 PT; we will run a smoke-test at 04:30.
- Staging perf: we completed load tests on 11/05 and saw 3–5% higher p99 than expected; Connor, we'll need a short tuning pass.

Open question: what are the exact rollback criteria you want us to use? We prefer explicit, measurable thresholds we can script.

Emily Carter
Program Manager, NovaHealth
emily.carter@novahealth.com

Subject: MAP update: Week 3 — action items, owners, and go-live checklist (updated)

Everyone — updated MAP attached (NH_MAP_v3.xlsx) with current statuses and dates. Key points: 

- Launch date: 2025-11-20 02:00 PT (DB migration window confirmed)
- Internal go/no-go review: 2025-11-13 11:00 PT (we will focus on certs, staging perf, and DocuSign completion)
- Runbook: included script snippets for rollback; see runbook_draft.md (Connor)

Current open action items (please confirm owners/ETAs):
1) FQDN list for wildcard certs — Owner: Marissa — Due: 2025-11-10 (status: partial)
2) Whitelist IPs & network approval — Owner: NovaHealth (Emily) — Due: 2025-11-12
3) Performance tuning & staging verification — Owner: Connor — Due: 2025-11-08 (status: in progress)
4) DocuSign signature of the addendum — Owner: NovaHealth procurement — Due: 2025-11-14
5) Final rollback script approval — Owner: Connor & NovaHealth dev ops — Due: 2025-11-12

Please reply with any changes. If we don’t get a hard block by 2025-11-13 11:00 PT we will proceed to final prep for the 11/20 cutover.

Attachments: NH_MAP_v3.xlsx, runbook_draft.md, cutover_plan_v1.pdf

Thanks —
Rishi

Thanks Rishi — final status from NovaHealth: 

- FQDN list: submitted this morning (see Drive).
- Whitelist IPs: network team will approve by EOD 11/12; I will confirm once complete.
- DocuSign: signatures in progress; target completion 11/14.
- Rollback script: we have one small request on the timeout thresholds; Connor, if you can push the suggested change by 11/12 18:00 PT we can sign off.

We’re OK to move to the internal go/no-go on 11/13. I’ll be on the call and will provide our final decision after the checklist review. If anything blocks us materially I’ll signal a hold immediately.
